abort.app_not_found: The local Bepacom app was not found. Start it or use manual setup.

app_unavailable.title: Bepacom app unavailable
app_unavailable.description: The Bepacom app or external gateway cannot be reached. Check that it is running and port 8099 is reachable.

gateway_incompatible.title: Incompatible Bepacom version
gateway_incompatible.description: The gateway supports neither Protocol V2 nor the required legacy API. Update the app and integration together.
